items.what: The humidity sensor class must be named DysonHumiditySensor and expose device_class == DEVICE_CLASS_HUMIDITY (also when device has no state).
The temperature sensor class DysonTemperatureSensor must expose device_class == DEVICE_CLASS_TEMPERATURE.
DysonDustSensor and DysonFilterLifeSensor must return device_class None (existing classes must keep no device_class).

reason: The issue names the humidity and pm25 device_class fix; the temperature device_class and the None device_class guards follow as the same mechanical change to the same sensor family. Class names (DysonHumiditySensor etc.) already exist in the repo, so they are guessable context rather than new API; no pm25-specific test exists, so nothing is not_inferable.
